purpose: Aligned material illustrations of the same transport tray for an interactive comparison; illustrative geometry, not a certified product specification.

assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: realistic industrial product photo for an interactive EPP versus EPS material comparison on PARK's website.
Primary request: one single moulded rectangular open-top protective transport tray made entirely of charcoal black expanded polypropylene (EPP) bead foam. This will be the source for an exactly registered second version in white EPS: choose extremely clear simple geometry.
Scene/backdrop: seamless matte very light cool grey studio floor and background, soft grounded shadow.
Subject: one empty open-top rectangular tray, thick flat rim, four thick walls, shallow flat inner floor, subtly rounded outer corners, simple slight mould draft. No separate lid, handles, holes, partitions, contents or extra pieces.
Style/medium: convincing high-end product photography, realistic dense fused EPP bead texture on every visible foam surface, fine irregular beads, tiny natural texture variation, dry matte foam, never shiny plastic or fabric.
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2 canvas. Stationary camera front three-quarter view looking slightly down so inside and two outside walls are visible. Center the complete product in the frame, occupying about 75% of image width and 65% of height, with generous equal margins. Camera around 65mm lens without wide-angle distortion. Straight physical geometry, crisp silhouette.
Lighting/mood: large diffuse softbox upper left; natural soft contact shadows; neutral clean industrial catalogue look, sharp foam detail.
Constraints: only ONE entire black EPP tray. NO split image, NO comparison panels, NO typography, labels, logo, watermark, people, hands, arrows or UI. Do not crop the tray. Produce a single 1536x1024 image.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Edit target: the attached single charcoal EPP tray studio photo. Create its matched WHITE EPS material version for an interactive before/after slider.
Change ONLY the foam material: replace charcoal black expanded polypropylene with white expanded polystyrene (EPS), with a realistic tightly fused white cellular bead surface, very subtle individual bead boundaries and matte highlights. The interior, rim, walls and underside must ALL be white EPS.
CRITICAL REGISTRATION: keep the tray's exact silhouette, every corner, outline, wall thickness, rim shape, visible inside floor, perspective, camera position, framing, scale, and position PIXEL-ALIGNED to the supplied image. The tray must neither move nor change shape. Keep every background pixel and the floor/contact shadow in the same location. The complete rectangular tray is the SAME product in the same pose; only material colour and surface texture change.
Lighting: keep identical upper-left studio light with realistic white foam shading. Preserve the grey background and shadows. Keep white foam distinguishable against grey by natural shading, never add outlines.
Constraints: one whole WHITE tray only, full 1536x1024 frame. Do not create split panels. No objects added or removed. No text, labels, logos, watermarks, hands, or UI. No crop or camera movement.

processing: Generated PNGs encoded as WebP quality 88 at native 1536x1024; no crop, recolouring or geometry changes.
